_readme: Guests type their own name on the site (matched case-insensitively, whitespace-trimmed) instead of using a per-guest link. Whoever matches sees only the events listed for them. This is a small hand-typed placeholder list — swap it for the client's Google Sheet once he sends it. The object key is just an internal id (used for the RSVP local-storage key); it's never shown to the guest.
